– Platform teams running AI agents
– Security engineers Happy to answer any technical questions.

To this day, the tech community has yet to establish a standard definition for "world models." However, this has not stopped it from becoming the most compelling narrative of the moment: in the eyes of VCs, it is the ultimate sandbox for validating business closed loops; in the field of embodied intelligence, it serves as the predictive brain that enables robots to "think three steps ahead"; and amidst the ruins of the metaverse, it is seen as the final piece of the puzzle for transitioning information carriers from 2D videos to 3D interactive worlds. On January 23, Bloomberg reported that Li Fei-Fei is in talks for a new round of funding for her startup, World Labs, targeting a valuation of approximately $5 billion. At a time when this concept has yet to be demystified, the Zhongguancun Early-Stage Investment Forum brought together several pioneers from diverse backgrounds. Rather than seeking vague consensus, they aimed to clarify the real commercial dynamics of this new AI wave through the collision of perspectives. At a roundtable forum moderated by Lin Juemin, Editor-in-Chief of Leiphone, participants included Wang Sheng, Partner at Innospring Capital; Wu Wei, Founder of Manifold AI; Song Yachen, Founder of VAST; and Jiang Yizhou, Partner at Qianjue Technology. The dialogue was not intended to seek mediocre consensus but to present a discussion on world models.  

The following is a transcript of the in-depth roundtable discussion:

Wu Wei: Manifold AI, founded just last June, focuses on world models, currently prioritizing the implementation of embodied brains for use in machinery and drones.

items.title: 百度卡位AI入口 文心助手率先跑出四倍增速
items.raw_excerpt: 2026年春节前夕，围绕AI展开的“红包大战”持续升温。流量高峰之下，真正的胜负开始体现在用户规模与使用深度上。最新数据显示，百度文心凭借四倍增长的月活，率先确立AI入口优势。   2月10日，百度文心公布数据：自春节红包活动启动以来，文心助手MAU同比增长4倍；其中，生图功能调用量同比增长50倍，生视频功能同比增长40倍，AI打电话功能增长近4倍。多项核心能力的同步爆发，意味着用户使用正从节日驱动的尝鲜体验，转向高频、真实场景下的持续使用。       增长背后，是产品路径的结构性升级。百度没选择单独打造新入口，而是将文心助手深度整合进百度App与搜索主入口，用户无需下载即可轻松使用文心助手AI能力。   例如，当用户在百度搜索“春节红包攻略”“年夜饭菜谱”“拜年话术”等内容时，文心助手会直接生成step-by-step答案、详细菜谱，甚至帮用户“打电话”给长辈送祝福。这种“搜索即AI”的无痛转场，让AI从尝鲜工具变成了解决问题的第一选择。   不同AI产品对“中国AI入口有哪些”的回答   更重要的是，依托20多年搜索能力积累，百度在理解用户意图与结果校验方面具备天然优势。相比单纯生成式回答，“搜索+生成”的双重机制，使内容可信度更高，在一定程度上降低了大模型“幻觉”风险。这种底层能力差异，成为用户留存与高频使用的重要基础。   高盛指出，百度是最被低估的AI流量入口。若未来搜索流量进一步向订酒店、购票等服务场景转化，百度AI业务估值仍具30%以上的上行空间。   在巩固AI入口优势的同时，百度也在加速夯实底层能力与生态布局。近期，百度智能云推出对热门开源AI Agent“OpenClaw”的一键部署方案，推动开发者与企业加速落地智能体，展现出在AI基础设施与生态开放方面的战略领先

excerpt_i18n.en:
On the eve of the 2026 Spring Festival, the "red envelope battle" centered around AI continues to intensify. Amid peak traffic, the true outcome is beginning to be reflected in user scale and depth of usage. Latest data shows that Baidu's Wenxin has taken the lead in establishing an AI gateway advantage, with a fourfold increase in monthly active users. On February 10, Baidu Wenxin released data: since the launch of the Spring Festival red envelope campaign, Wenxin Assistant's MAU has grown fourfold year-over-year; among its features, image generation calls increased 50-fold, video generation calls rose 40-fold, and AI phone call functionality grew nearly fourfold. The simultaneous surge in multiple core capabilities indicates that user engagement is shifting from festival-driven trial experiences to sustained, high-frequency use in real-world scenarios.

Behind this growth lies a structural upgrade in the product strategy. Instead of creating a separate new gateway, Baidu deeply integrated Wenxin Assistant into the Baidu App and its primary search interface, allowing users to easily access Wenxin Assistant's AI capabilities without downloading additional apps. For example, when users search for content like "Spring Festival red envelope strategies," "New Year's Eve dinner recipes," or "New Year greeting phrases" on Baidu, Wenxin Assistant directly generates step-by-step answers, detailed recipes, and even helps users "make calls" to elders to send blessings. This seamless "search as AI" transition has turned AI from a novelty tool into the first choice for problem-solving.

More importantly, leveraging over 20 years of search technology accumulation and massive user data, Baidu has built a robust foundation for AI applications. This enables Wenxin Assistant to provide more accurate, personalized services in complex scenarios, further solidifying its leading position in the AI gateway competition.
excerpt_i18n.es: En vísperas de la Fiesta de la Primavera de 2026, la "guerra de los sobres rojos" centrada en la IA continúa intensificándose. Bajo el pico de tráfico, la verdadera victoria comienza a reflejarse en la escala de usuarios y la profundidad de uso. Los últimos datos muestran que Baidu Wenxin, con un crecimiento cuádruple en usuarios activos mensuales, ha establecido ventaja como puerta de entrada a la IA. El 10 de febrero, Baidu Wenxin reveló cifras: desde el inicio de la campaña de sobres rojos, los MAU del asistente Wenxin aumentaron 4 veces interanual; entre ellas, las llamadas a la función de generación de imágenes crecieron 50 veces, la de generación de videos 40 veces, y la función de llamadas telefónicas con IA casi 4 veces. La explosión simultánea de múltiples capacidades clave indica que el uso por parte de los usuarios está pasando de experiencias ocasionales impulsadas por festividades a escenarios frecuentes y reales.

items.title: 创新Transformer！面壁基于稀疏-线性混合架构SALA训练9B模型，端侧跑通百万上下文
items.raw_excerpt: 众所周知，Transformer 及其核心的全注意力机制（Full Attention）虽长期占据大模型架构的核心地位，但平方级计算复杂度、高额显存占用的瓶颈，早已成为实现超长上下文处理与模型规模化应用的 “拦路虎”。敢于挑战这一固有权威，需要的不仅是实现 AGI 长远目标勇于创新的魄力，更需要有独到的技术视野以及突破技术壁垒的硬实力。从 DeepSeek 的稀疏注意力（DSA）、MiniMax 的线性注意力、到月之暗面的线性注意力（KDA），大家纷纷投入注意力架构的革新竞技场。 今天，面壁智能也在这场变革中迈出了关键一步：正式发布行业首个大规模训练的稀疏-线性注意力混合架构 SALA（Sparse Attention-Linear Attention，简称SALA），以及基于该架构的文本模型 MiniCPM-SALA，以追求更长文本处理能力与极致的推理性价比。MiniCPM-SALA 不仅在多项长文本理解与生成评测中优势明显，且在知识问答、数学推理、代码生成等核心能力维度上，保持了与同规模全注意力模型相当的卓越水平，实现了“长短兼备”的综合性能表现，以及极致推理性价比。 ▍MiniCPM-SALA 亮点一览  ▪ 架构革新：“稀疏-线性”注意力混合架构，在显著降低推理开销与显存占用的同时，克服了纯线性架构在长程信息召回上的精度瓶颈，效率性能兼顾。 ▪ 卓越性能：采用HyPE（混合位置编码）来有效协调短上下文和长上下文的性能。在保持通用能力（如知识、数学和编码）与其他8B全注意力模型相当的同时，MiniCPM-SALA 在多个长上下文基准测试中表现出明显优势。 ▪ 高效推理：不使用投机采样等加速算法，在云端推理芯片上，当序列长度为256K词元时推理速度高达 Qwen3-8B 的 3.5 倍，并支持在云端芯片和消费级端侧 GPU 上进行

excerpt_i18n.en: As the Spring Festival approaches, let's try something fun: envisioning Thanos and the Avengers setting off fireworks together. This video was generated in a single prompt using Vidu Q3, achieving synchronized audio and visuals, high-definition output, multiple camera transitions, and a complete scene narrative. Tras Sora, la generación de videos con IA compite frenéticamente por aumentar la duración. Cuando Sora se lanzó, solo podía generar videos de unos 5 segundos, mientras que Vidu acaba de presentar Vidu Q3, el primer modelo global que soporta salida directa de audio y video, capaz de producir 16 segundos con audio y video sincronizados, además de una mayor capacidad narrativa y control de planos.
